1052.description: Hold a fixed bar and sit your hips back to stretch your back and lats. It opens the upper body.
instructions: Grip a fixed bar or post at about hip height.
Step back until your arms are straight.
Sink your hips back and let your chest drop.
Feel the stretch along your back and sides.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.

1116.description: A push-up with the hands in the straps and the body angled upward, a gentler version that builds the chest.
instructions: Hold the handles and walk your feet back so your body is at a slant.
Keep your body straight and core tight.
Lower your chest to the handles by bending the elbows.
Keep elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press up to straight arms.
Walk your feet back to make it harder.

1180.description: A floor core move where both legs work together in an alternating pattern, challenging the lower abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your hands under your hips or at your sides.
Press your lower back into the floor and brace your abs.
Raise one leg while the other lowers toward the floor, keeping both straight.
Switch legs in a smooth scissor pattern without letting your back arch.
Continue for the planned reps or time.

1244.description: Small alternating leg kicks while lying down. They fire up the lower abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and hands under your hips.
Lift your legs a few inches off the floor.
Kick your legs up and down in small alternating motions.
Keep your lower back pressed to the floor.
Continue for a set time and breathe steadily.

1308.description: A bench press on a smith machine with a wide grip. The fixed bar path lets you focus on pressing, with extra work for the outer chest.
instructions: Adjust the bench to a comfortable position on the smith machine.
Lie down on the bench with your feet flat on the ground.
Grasp the barbell with a wide grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the barbell and lower it slowly towards your chest, keeping your elbows out to the sides.
Pause for a moment when the barbell touches your chest.
Push the barbell back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将史密斯机上的长凳调整到舒适的位置。
躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地上。
宽握距抓住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
松开杠铃并将其慢慢降低到胸部，保持肘部向两侧伸出。
当杠铃触及胸部时暂停片刻。
将杠铃推回到起始位置，完全伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

1372.description: Stand with a barbell on your upper back and rise onto your toes. It builds the calves and ankle strength.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place a barbell across your upper back.
Raise your heels off the ground as high as possible, using only your toes.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将杠铃放在上背部。
仅用脚趾将脚后跟抬离地面，尽可能高。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1436.description: The classic back squat with the bar sitting high on the traps and a more upright torso. It is a staple for quad and glute strength.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned out.
Place the barbell on your upper back, resting it on your traps.
Engage your core and keep your chest up as you begin to squat down, pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
Lower yourself until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Drive through your heels to stand back up, extending your hips and knees.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，脚趾稍微向外。
将杠铃放在上背部，放在斜方肌上。
当你开始蹲下时，启动你的核心并保持胸部挺直，将臀部向后推并弯曲膝盖。
放低身体，直到大腿与地面平行，或者尽可能低到您能舒服的高度。
通过脚后跟站起来，伸展臀部和膝盖。
重复所需的重复次数。

1500.description: An upright row where the band is held under both feet. It builds the shoulders and upper traps.
instructions: Stand with both feet on the middle of the band and hold the ends in front of your thighs.
Keep your chest up and your core tight.
Pull your hands up along your body until they reach chest height, elbows leading.
Pause briefly without shrugging too high.
Lower slowly back down.

1564.description: A deeper stretch for the hip flexors and quads, using a rope or strap to pull the foot toward you.
instructions: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold onto a stable object for support.
Bend your right knee and bring your right foot towards your glutes, grabbing the rope with your right hand.
Slowly pull your right foot towards your glutes, feeling a stretch in your right quad.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds.
Release the stretch and repeat on the left side.
instructionsZh: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽。
抓住一个稳定的物体作为支撑。
弯曲右膝，将右脚移向臀部，用右手抓住绳子。
慢慢地将右脚拉向臀部，感受右股四头肌的拉伸。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒。
松开拉伸并在左侧重复。

1628.description: A spider curl with an EZ bar, lying chest down on an incline bench. It isolates the biceps with no swing.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the ez barbell with an underhand grip, palms facing up.
Rest your upper arms on a preacher bench or stability ball, allowing your elbows to hang down.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the barbell up towards your shoulders.
Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，反手握住杠铃，手掌朝上。
将上臂放在牧师凳或稳定球上，让肘部下垂。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将杠铃向上弯向肩膀。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气并慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1692.description: A forward lunge combined with an overhead medicine ball press that links leg strength with shoulder work.
instructions: Hold a medicine ball at chest height and stand tall.
Step forward into a lunge and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Press the ball overhead as you rise.
Lower the ball and step back to the start.
Alternate legs for the planned reps.

1756.description: A one-leg hip hinge holding a barbell. Trains the glutes and hamstrings while challenging balance and core stability.
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a barbell in front of your thighs with an overhand grip.
Shift your weight onto your left foot and lift your right foot slightly off the ground.
Hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and your right leg extended behind you for balance.
Lower the barbell towards the ground, keeping it close to your body and your left leg slightly bent.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then engage your glutes and hamstrings to lift your torso back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
instructionsZh: 站立，双脚分开与臀部同宽，正手握住杠铃在大腿前面。
将重心转移到左脚上，并将右脚稍微抬离地面。
臀部向前转动，保持背部挺直，右腿向后伸展以保持平衡。
将杠铃向地面降低，使其靠近身体，左腿稍微弯曲。
在底部暂停片刻，然后启动臀肌和腿筋，将躯干抬回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

1820.description: Resting your arms on a preacher bench while holding an EZ bar lets the arms extend fully, stretching the biceps.
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench and rest your upper arms on the pad, holding an EZ bar.
Let the bar lower under control until your arms are fully extended, using a light load.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1884.description: Lie on a bench and let one leg hang across for a gravity-assisted hip stretch.
instructions: Lie on your back on a bench.
Cross one leg over your body and let it hang off the side.
Keep your shoulders flat.
Let gravity lower the leg slowly.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

1948.description: A seated rotation that works the hip through a twisting stretch.
instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and both feet flat.
Let both knees drop to one side and rotate your torso the opposite way until you feel the hip stretch.
Keep your hands behind you for support.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

2140.description: A low-impact cardio machine session that works the legs in a smooth walking motion to raise your heart rate.
instructions: Step onto the machine and hold the handles lightly.
Start moving your legs in a smooth walking rhythm.
Keep your posture tall and your core lightly braced.
Pick a pace that lets you breathe steadily.
Keep going for 10-30 minutes depending on your fitness.
Slow down for the last minute before stepping off.

2204.description: A plank with forearms on a roller, rolling forward and back like a saw. Challenges the abs and core.
instructions: Start in a plank position with your forearms on the roller and your body in a straight line.
Engage your core and slowly roll the roller forward, extending your body as far as you can while maintaining control.
Pause for a moment at the furthest point, then slowly roll the roller back towards your starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 从平板支撑位置开始，前臂放在滚轴上，身体呈一条直线。
启动你的核心并缓慢向前滚动滚轮，在保持控制的同时尽可能地伸展你的身体。
在最远点暂停片刻，然后慢慢地将滚轮滚回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2268.description: A seated machine crunch where the hands press on a pad, working the abs against steady resistance.
instructions: Sit on the machine and adjust the seat so your hands reach the pad.
Place your hands on the pads and brace your feet.
Curl your torso forward by contracting your abs.
Pause briefly at the bottom.
Return slowly to the upright start.
Repeat for the planned reps.

2396.description: Lying on your back with a cable pulling from the floor, you curl the handle toward your shoulders to isolate the biceps under steady tension.
instructions: Lie on your back on the floor facing the cable stack and hold the bar or handle with palms up.
Keep your upper arms still and pinned to the floor.
Curl the handle toward your shoulders, squeezing the biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight.
Keep your back flat and avoid lifting your shoulders as you curl.

2716.description: A heavy walk in a circle holding a load, building grip, back and leg strength.
instructions: Pick up the load and hold it against your body.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Walk in a circle with steady steps.
Stay balanced and avoid leaning away.
Set the load down under control when you finish.

2780.description: Rotating the upper arm inward, working the muscles that turn the shoulder in.
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand with your elbow at your side bent at 90 degrees, forearm pointing forward.
Rotate your forearm inward across your stomach, keeping the elbow tucked in.
Pause briefly, then return slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2844.description: A face-down back lift that strengthens the spine and glutes.
instructions: Lie face down with arms extended in front.
Lengthen your neck.
Lift your arms, chest and legs off the floor.
Hold briefly.
Lower slowly.

2908.description: Walking a loaded sled forward while resisting twist from a side-on pull or hold. It builds hip and trunk stability under load.
instructions: Set a light load and stand side-on to the pull, gripping the handle at chest height.
Brace your abs and keep your hips and shoulders square.
Walk forward in controlled steps without letting the torso twist.
Walk the set distance, then reset and repeat.
Switch sides and do the same distance.

2972.description: Stepping out to the side into a deep lunge. It works the quads and glutes while opening the inner thighs.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet together and hands in front of your chest.
Step wide to one side.
Bend that knee and sit your hips back, keeping the other leg straight.
Push off the bent leg to return.
Alternate sides.

3228.description: A face-down lift of your chest off the floor. It strengthens the lower back muscles.
instructions: Lie face down with your hands beside your head.
Keep your legs straight and your feet on the floor.
Lift your chest using your lower back.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your neck in line with your spine.

3292.description: A bodyweight hinge forward and back up again with the hands on the hips. It works the upper back and the muscles along the spine.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Place your hands on your hips or cross them in front of your chest.
Keeping your back straight, slowly bend forward at the waist, lowering your upper body towards the ground.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly raise your upper body back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲。
将双手放在臀部或交叉放在胸前。
保持背部挺直，腰部慢慢向前弯曲，将上半身向地面降低。
在底部停顿片刻，然后慢慢抬起上半身回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3356.description: A forward stepping lunge with cable tension, working quads and glutes.
instructions: Hold a low cable handle at your chest and stand facing away from the stack.
Take a big step forward.
Drop your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front knee stable over the ankle.
Push back to the start and switch legs.

3420.description: A seated hold with both the legs and the upper body lifted into a V shape. It trains the abs, hip flexors and balance.
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you.
Lean back slightly and lift your legs off the ground, keeping them straight.
Simultaneously, lift your upper body off the ground and reach your arms towards your legs.
Hold this position for a few seconds, then slowly lower your upper body and legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在地板上，双腿伸到身前。
稍微向后倾斜，将双腿抬离地面，保持伸直。
同时，将上半身抬离地面，并将手臂伸向腿部。
保持这个姿势几秒钟，然后慢慢降低上半身和双腿回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3484.description: A sit-up that finishes by driving one elbow toward the opposite knee. It works the abs and obliques.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands behind your head.
Curl up and rotate your torso, bringing one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower your back to the floor with control.
Repeat on the other side, alternating.
Avoid pulling on your neck.

3548.description: A one-handed overhead carry, walking while holding a dumbbell above your head. It trains the shoulders, core and balance.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in one hand.
Raise the dumbbell overhead, fully extending your arm.
Engage your core and keep your back straight as you walk forward, maintaining the dumbbell overhead.
Continue walking for the desired distance or time.
Switch hands and repeat the exercise.
instructionsZh: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽，一手握住哑铃。
将哑铃举过头顶，充分伸展手臂。
向前行走时，启动核心肌群并保持背部挺直，将哑铃举过头顶。
继续步行所需的距离或时间。
交换双手并重复练习。

3676.description: Jump rope with an alternating skip step for a lighter, rhythmic cardio workout.
instructions: Hold the rope handles and swing the rope overhead.
Skip over the rope, alternating feet.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep your elbows near your sides.
Continue at a steady pace.

3740.description: A lateral raise using a kettlebell, which trains the side delts.
instructions: Stand holding a kettlebell in one hand at your side.
Keep a soft bend in your elbow.
Raise your arm out to the side to shoulder height.
Lower it slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

3868.description: A cable fly with your chest against a bench, which isolates the pecs with steady tension.
instructions: Set the pulleys at about shoulder height and position an incline bench facing the stack, chest against the pad.
Hold a handle in each hand with arms out to the sides.
With a slight bend in your elbows, sweep your arms forward in a wide arc.
Squeeze your chest as the handles meet.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch across the chest.

3996.description: Draw circles with straight arms to warm up the shoulders. It loosens the shoulder joints.
instructions: Stand tall with arms out to the sides.
Make small circles forward.
Increase to larger circles.
Reverse the direction.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.

4060.description: A push up combined with extending an opposite arm and leg. It builds the chest while testing core balance.
instructions: Start in a high plank.
Lower into a push up with elbows about 45 degrees from your body.
Press back up.
Lift one arm and the opposite leg and hold briefly.
Return and alternate sides each rep.

4124.description: A dead bug holding a medicine ball overhead to add trunk control demand.
instructions: Lie on your back holding a medicine ball above your chest, knees bent over your hips.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lower the ball overhead while extending the opposite leg.
Return to the start.
Alternate sides.

4188.description: A reverse crunch holding an EZ bar behind your head. It targets the lower abs.
instructions: Lie on your back holding an EZ bar overhead.
Lift your legs with knees bent.
Curl your hips off the floor.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your arms steady.

4252.description: A crunch with weight held on your chest or behind your head. The added load makes the abs work harder.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a weight against your chest.
Curl your shoulders and upper back off the floor.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your chin off your chest.

4380.description: A standing exercise where one foot slides on a towel to work the hips and thighs while the standing leg balances you.
instructions: Stand on a smooth floor with one foot on a towel and hold a support if needed.
Bend the standing knee slightly and keep your chest tall.
Slide the towel foot out to the side or back as far as you can control.
Pull it back to the start using your hip and thigh muscles.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

4444.description: A rear-foot-elevated split squat holding a kettlebell, with a free hand on a support. Builds single-leg strength in the quads and glutes.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at your chest in one hand and rest the other hand on a sturdy support, standing away from a bench.
Place the top of your rear foot on a bench behind you.
Step your front foot far enough forward to stay balanced.
Lower straight down until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee tracking over your toes.
Drive through the front heel to stand, then switch legs after your set.

4572.description: A diagonal dumbbell pattern from a half kneeling stance that trains rotational core strength.
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward and hold a dumbbell with both hands.
Start with the weight by your low outside hip.
Lift the dumbbell diagonally across your body to above the opposite shoulder.
Rotate your torso and keep your hips square.
Chop it back down along the same line.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

4700.description: Combining a side bend and an overhead press with a band. It trains the shoulders and obliques.
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the end in one hand at your shoulder.
Press the band overhead as you bend gently to the opposite side.
Keep your hips steady and your chest open.
Return to upright as you lower your hand.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

4764.description: A hyperextension on the glute ham bench with a twist at the top. It works the lower back, glutes and obliques.
instructions: Position yourself on the bench with hips on the pad and feet locked in.
Cross your arms on your chest.
Lower your torso with a straight back.
Raise up to a straight line and rotate your torso to one side.
Untwist, lower, and alternate sides.

4892.description: A one legged squat with the working foot raised on a step. It builds leg strength and balance.
instructions: Stand on a bench or box on one leg with the other leg hanging off the edge.
Reach your arms forward for balance.
Sit your hips back and bend the standing knee to lower.
Go as deep as you can while the knee tracks over your toes.
Push through the foot to stand back up.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

5148.description: A lunge jump where you land on a single leg. It builds explosive leg power and balance.
instructions: Stand in a lunge position.
Lower down, then jump explosively off your front leg.
Land softly on the same leg.
Control the next repetition, keeping your torso upright.
Switch legs after your reps.

5404.description: Swinging a stick from front to back in a wide arc to open up the shoulders. A classic warm-up for shoulder mobility.
instructions: Stand tall and hold the stick in front of you with a wide overhand grip.
Keep your arms straight and raise the stick overhead.
Carry it back behind your body in a smooth arc.
Return the same way to the start.
Repeat for 8-10 slow passes and narrow your grip as you get more flexible.

5660.description: Bench press from pins in the rack, starting from a dead stop at the chest.
instructions: Set the pins just above your chest.
Lie under the bar with a firm grip.
Press the bar up.
Lower to the pins and pause.
Repeat.

5916.description: A seated overhead triceps extension on a high pulley that keeps constant tension on the back of the arms.
instructions: Sit facing away from a high pulley and hold the handle overhead with both hands.
Keep your upper arms close to your ears and elbows pointing forward.
Straighten your arms to extend the handle up.
Slowly bend your elbows to lower it behind your head.
Keep your torso upright and your upper arms still.

5980.description: A flowing sequence linking breath and movement. Warms up the whole body.
instructions: Stand in mountain pose and sweep your arms overhead.
Fold forward and step back to plank.
Lower, then press into upward dog and downward dog.
Step forward, rise and return to mountain.
Repeat the flow at a steady pace.

6044.description: A squat holding weighted bottles at shoulder height. It works the quads and glutes and keeps your torso upright.
instructions: Hold a bottle in each hand at your shoulders, elbows pointing forward.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit your hips down and back until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Press through your heels to stand.

6108.description: A floor-based curl where you bend the knees against no added load. It targets the hamstrings in a simple way.
instructions: Lie on your front with your legs straight.
Rest your forehead on your hands.
Bend your knees and bring your heels toward your glutes.
Squeeze the hamstrings at the top.
Lower your feet slowly back to the floor.
Keep your hips pressed down throughout.

6300.description: A V-shaped balance on your sit bones. It strengthens the abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Sit with knees bent and lean back a little.
Lift your feet so your shins are parallel to the floor.
Extend your arms forward.
Keep your chest open and spine long.
Hold for 15-30 seconds.

6364.description: Seated reverse wrist curl with your forearms supported on your thighs, isolating the top of your forearms.
instructions: Sit and rest your forearms on your thighs, holding an EZ bar overhand.
Let your wrists hang past your knees.
Extend your wrists to lift the bar.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

6428.description: Lying on your back with your knees bent, you reach side to side to tap your heels, working your obliques.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Lift your shoulders slightly off the floor.
Reach your right hand toward your right heel.
Switch and reach your left hand to your left heel.
Keep your core tight and continue alternating.

6748.description: A hamstring curl done from a kneeling position, one leg at a time. It works the back of the thigh.
instructions: Get on all fours with hands under shoulders.
Keep your back flat and core tight.
Bend one knee and curl your heel toward your glute.
Squeeze the hamstring at the top.
Lower the foot slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

6812.description: A seated move using a ball to wake up the inner upper thigh. It works the pectineus and the nearby adductors.
instructions: Sit tall on a chair with a ball between your knees.
Place your feet flat and keep your back straight.
Squeeze the ball gently with your thighs.
Hold the squeeze for 5-10 seconds.
Relax and repeat several times.

8220.description: A full-depth bodyweight squat. It builds leg strength and works the mobility of hips and ankles.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit your hips back and down as deep as you can.
Keep your heels down and chest up.
Pause at the bottom.
Drive up to standing.

8604.description: A plate-loaded seated curl that isolates the hamstrings.
instructions: Sit in the machine and adjust the pad above your ankles.
Keep your back against the support.
Curl your heels down and back as far as you can.
Squeeze your hamstrings briefly.
Return slowly without letting the weight crash.

9180.description: Holding a stick behind your back, you lift it away to open the front of the shoulders. It improves shoulder extension.
instructions: Stand tall holding a stick behind your back with an overhand grip.
Keep your arms straight.
Lift the stick back and away from your body.
Stay tall and avoid leaning forward.
Hold for a moment.
Lower slowly and repeat.

9692.description: A squat into a press with kettlebells, alternating arms. It is a full-body conditioning move.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in each hand at shoulder height.
Squat down with your chest tall.
Drive up and press one kettlebell overhead.
Lower it back to your shoulder as you squat again.
Press the other arm on the next rep.

10588.description: Lying on a bench, you raise a barbell from your thighs to above your chest. It builds the front shoulder.
instructions: Lie on a bench holding a barbell at arm's length over your thighs.
Keep your arms straight with a soft elbow.
Raise the bar in an arc until it is above your chest.
Lower it slowly back down.
Use a light weight and keep your back flat.

10780.description: Gentle chin tuck while lying on your back. It strengthens the front neck muscles.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Relax your shoulders.
Tuck your chin and lift your head slightly off the floor.
Hold for a second.
Lower slowly.
Keep the motion small and smooth.

10908.description: Seated ankle circles on one leg. They loosen the ankle and warm up the lower leg.
instructions: Sit tall on a chair and lift one foot slightly off the floor.
Keep your lower leg still.
Draw slow circles with your toes, as wide as is comfortable.
Do half your reps clockwise, then switch to counterclockwise.
Repeat on the other foot.

0028.description: Lift the bar from the floor to your shoulders in one movement, then press it overhead. A full-body power exercise.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and the barbell on the floor in front of you.
Bend your knees and hinge at the hips to lower down and grip the barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Drive through your heels and extend your hips and knees to lift the barbell off the floor, keeping it close to your body.
As the barbell reaches your thighs, explosively extend your hips, shrug your shoulders, and pull the barbell up towards your chest.
As the barbell reaches chest height, quickly drop under it and catch it at shoulder level, with your elbows pointing forward and your palms facing up.
From the catch position, press the barbell overhead by extending your arms and pushing the barbell straight up.
Lower the barbell back down to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，杠铃放在你面前的地板上。
弯曲膝盖并以臀部为铰链降低并用正手握住杠铃，双手分开略宽于肩宽。
通过脚后跟发力，伸展臀部和膝盖，将杠铃抬离地板，使其靠近身体。
当杠铃到达大腿时，爆发性伸展臀部，耸肩，并将杠铃拉向胸部。
当杠铃到达胸部高度时，迅速将其降至肩部水平，肘部向前，手掌朝上。
从接球位置开始，伸展双臂并将杠铃笔直向上推，将杠铃压过头顶。
将杠铃放回起始位置，然后重复所需的重复次数。

0092.description: A seated overhead extension holding the bar. Isolates the triceps.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a barbell with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart, and raise it overhead.
Lower the barbell behind your head by bending your elbows, keeping your upper arms close to your head.
Pause for a moment, then extend your arms to raise the barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地上。
正手握住杠铃，双手与肩同宽，并将其举过头顶。
弯曲肘部，将杠铃降低到脑后，保持上臂靠近头部。
暂停片刻，然后伸展双臂将杠铃举回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0220.description: A cable shrug with the arms hanging in front. You lift the shoulders toward the ears to train the traps.
instructions: Stand facing the cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the cable handles with an overhand grip and let your arms hang down in front of you.
Keeping your arms straight, shrug your shoulders up towards your ears.
Hold the contraction for a moment, then slowly lower your shoulders back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 面对电缆机站立，双脚与肩同宽。
正手握住电缆手柄，让手臂垂在身前。
保持手臂伸直，耸肩向耳朵方向向上。
保持收缩一会儿，然后慢慢将肩膀放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0284.description: A donkey calf raise with the toes on a raised surface. You lift and lower the heels through a full range to work the calves.
instructions: Stand with your toes on an elevated surface, such as a step or block.
Place your hands on a stable support, such as a wall or railing, for balance.
Raise your heels as high as possible, lifting your body weight onto the balls of your feet.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将脚趾站立在升高的表面上，例如台阶或木块。
将双手放在稳定的支撑物上，例如墙壁或栏杆，以保持平衡。
尽可能高地抬高脚后跟，将身体重量转移到脚掌上。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0348.description: Chest-down on a bench, you raise dumbbells out to the sides. It targets the rear shoulders and upper back muscles.
instructions: Lie face down on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
Extend your arms straight down towards the floor, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Engaging your shoulder muscles, lift your arms out to the sides until they are parallel to the floor.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 脸朝下躺在平坦的长凳上，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌相对。
将手臂伸直向下伸向地板，肘部保持轻微弯曲。
调动肩部肌肉，将手臂向两侧抬起，直到与地板平行。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0412.description: A dumbbell squat with a stability ball pinned between your back and a wall. The ball guides the movement and takes stress off your lower back.
instructions: Place a stability ball between your lower back and a wall and hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Step your feet forward, shoulder width apart.
Bend your knees and sink down as the ball rolls up your back.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Push through your heels to stand back up.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

0476.description: Hanging from a bar, you raise your straight legs while twisting your hips. It trains the abs and obliques.
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with your arms fully extended and your legs straight.
Engage your core and lift your legs up towards your chest, keeping them straight.
Once your legs are parallel to the ground, twist your hips to one side, bringing your legs towards that side.
Pause for a moment, then return to the starting position.
Repeat the movement, but this time twist your hips to the opposite side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 悬挂在引体向上杆上，双臂完全伸展，双腿伸直。
启动你的核心并将双腿抬向胸部，保持伸直。
一旦双腿与地面平行，将臀部向一侧扭转，将双腿移向一侧。
暂停片刻，然后回到起始位置。
重复这个动作，但这次将臀部扭向另一侧。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

0540.description: Use a small leg dip and drive to push one kettlebell overhead. It lets you move more weight than a strict press and trains shoulders, triceps and legs.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in one hand at shoulder level.
Bend your knees slightly and engage your core.
Press the kettlebell overhead by extending your arm and fully extending your legs.
Lower the kettlebell back to the starting position by bending your knees and bringing the kettlebell back to your shoulder.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，一只手握住壶铃，与肩同高。
稍微弯曲膝盖并启动核心。
伸展手臂并完全伸展双腿，将壶铃压过头顶。
弯曲膝盖并将壶铃放回肩膀，将壶铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

0604.description: On a lever machine, you lift your shoulders straight up and lower with control. Builds the upper traps.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the leverage machine with your back against the pad.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and keep your arms straight.
Keeping your back straight, lift your shoulders up towards your ears as high as possible.
Hold the contraction for a moment, then slowly lower your shoulders back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度，将自己放在杠杆机上，背部靠在垫子上。
正手握住手柄并保持手臂伸直。
保持背部挺直，将肩膀尽可能高地抬向耳朵。
保持收缩一会儿，然后慢慢将肩膀放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0668.description: Lying on your back, you lift your hips and hold with your feet on the floor. Works the glutes, hamstrings and lower back.
instructions: Lie on your back with your feet flat on the ground and your knees bent.
Place your arms by your sides with your palms facing down.
Engage your glutes and hamstrings, and lift your hips off the ground until your body forms a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Hold this position for a few seconds, then slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 仰卧，双脚平放在地上，膝盖弯曲。
将手臂放在身体两侧，手掌朝下。
收紧臀肌和腿筋，将臀部抬离地面，直到身体从膝盖到肩膀形成一条直线。
保持这个姿势几秒钟，然后慢慢地将臀部放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0796.description: A standing ab wheel rollout, rolling the wheel out in front while hinging at the waist. It is a tough core exercise for the abs.
instructions: Start by standing tall with your feet shoulder-width apart and the wheel roller in front of you.
Bend at your waist and slowly roll the wheel forward, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Continue rolling forward until you feel a stretch in your abs and your body is extended as far as possible.
Pause for a moment, then slowly roll the wheel back towards your body, returning to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先，站直，双脚分开与肩同宽，滚轮位于您的前方。
弯腰，慢慢向前滚动轮子，保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
继续向前滚动，直到感觉到腹肌拉伸并且身体尽可能伸展。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢地将轮子向身体方向滚动，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0860.description: A cable triceps kickback, hinging forward and extending the forearm back. It isolates the triceps.
instructions: Stand facing a cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the cable handle with your right hand and step back to create tension in the cable.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Keep your upper arm close to your body and your elbow bent at a 90-degree angle.
Extend your forearm backward, straightening your arm fully.
Pause for a moment, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
instructionsZh: 面向缆绳机站立，双脚与肩同宽。
用右手握住电缆手柄并后退以在电缆中产生张力。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
保持上臂靠近身体，肘部弯曲成 90 度角。
向后伸展前臂，完全伸直手臂。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

0924.description: An internal rotation with a band. It strengthens the rotator cuff.
instructions: Anchor the band at elbow height and stand sideways to it.
Hold the end with your elbow bent at 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm across toward your belly.
Return slowly.
Finish reps, then switch arms.

0988.description: A standing one-arm low row with a band. It trains the back and biceps.
instructions: Attach the band to a stable anchor point at waist height.
Stand facing the anchor point with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the band with one hand, palm facing inward, and step back to create tension in the band.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Pull the band towards your waist, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly release the band back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
instructionsZh: 将带子固定在腰部高度的稳定锚点上。
面向锚点站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
用一只手握住弹力带，手掌朝内，然后后退以在弹力带中产生张力。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
将带子拉向腰部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢松开弹力带回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。
